title: The Great Passage (bc30)
synopsis: After struggling in the sales division of the Genbu Books publishing company, Majime manages to land his dream job in the Dictionary Editorial Department, where he can use his talents to compile a new dictionary, The Great Passage. Partnering with Majime is a callow young man who is slow to develop an appreciation for the challenging task ahead. Majime's love of language, however, leaves him speechless when he meets the love of his life, Kaguya. Meanwhile, complications begin piling up as the dictionary department descends into chaos.

synopsis_lang.en: After struggling in the sales division of the Genbu Books publishing company, Majime manages to land his dream job in the Dictionary Editorial Department, where he can use his talents to compile a new dictionary, The Great Passage. synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 在出版社幽暗的一角，坐着早被遺忘的「字典編輯部」，總編輯卻激情地宣佈要編著一本革命性新辭典《大渡海》， 盡收天下潮語。恃有幾分型男本錢的小編西岡不為所動，主編眼見後繼無人，招聘書蟲馬締。此時，馬締遇上了女神小香，但飽讀詩書的他竟然找不到文字表達心跡。此時，出版社下令腰斬《大渡海》！馬締和西岡為了保住字典的性命，毅然作出大膽行動！老總說，找到最恰當的文字是最幸福的事，馬締在字海浮沉，終於開竅了……真正的語言藝術，讓他找到了人生目標，也找到了真愛。

cast: Joe Odagiri, Ryuhei Matsuda, Aoi Miyazaki, Haru Kuroki
